fixed.problem: Blocking (review of L4-creds-8). Usually a person finds out about a refusal by pressing Start: the run meets the 401, the refused card is filed, and the session ends but is kept to go on (S-10). After that, chat's 'start a session' said 'Your session of 09:23 goes on by itself once its Claude credential is back.'. That sentence names no step. At the same moment the Start dialog said 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.' with Start off.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-chat-refused.test.ts > "a refused key met by the person's Start: chat's start says the dialog's sentence, also after a restart" and "a refused sign-in met by the person's Start: chat's start says the dialog's sentence" (both got 'Your session of 10:00 goes on by itself once its Claude credential is back.'); packages/commands/test/start-refusal-order.test.ts > 'both ports answer: the dialog's refusal is said, at the read-back and at the yes, and nothing starts'
fixed.how: There were two causes, and both are fixed. (1) Chat's startBlocked port in compose.ts passed the credential wait only when `w.save && !w.startable && !w.kept`. The `!w.kept` exclusion was meant for a resting credential. It also dropped a refused credential's wait whenever a session was kept. A resting wait never carries a save link, so `save` alone identifies a refusal. The port now passes `w.save && !w.startable`. (2) session.start (packages/commands/src/commands/session.ts) checked refuseWhileWaiting (startWaits, the one-wait rule) before refuseBlockedStart. Both plan() and run() now check refuseBlockedStart first: the dialog's refusal comes first, then the one-wait rule. A resting credential still gets the one-wait sentence ('Your session of 10:00 goes on by itself at 15:40.'), because chat's port does not treat a resting wait as a refusal.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Set up a project with only a refused API key (policy 'API key only') and one ready task. Press Start session, then Start. The Inbox shows 'Anthropic refused your API key', and the bar reads 'Field notes · waiting for a new API key, then it goes on'. In the project's Chat, type 'start a session'. The reply is 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.', with no Yes/No, and no new session starts. Open Start session: the dialog shows the same sentence and Start is off. Quit and reopen Forerunner, then type 'start a session' again: the reply is the same. For a refused Claude sign-in under 'Subscription first, then wait', the reply is 'Nothing can run until you save a new Claude sign-in in Settings.'. Live check (session lead, real model): run the same steps with an expired subscription sign-in. The chat reply must equal the Start dialog's sentence word for word.

fixed.problem: Non-blocking (review of L4-creds-3). ToldByCards.credential matched an open refused or ask card by source_id only. An open ask card of an earlier stop on the same credential therefore hid this session's wait from its news: no session-end notification and no Update, while no open card told that wait.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/credential-notify-once.test.ts > "an open ask card of an earlier stop does not hide the session's wait in its news" (no session_ended naming 'Waits until 15:40')
fixed.how: In the told check (packages/runtime/src/session/runner.ts), an ask card now counts only when its stop_key equals the wait's stopKey (or the wait has no stopKey), and a refused card counts only for a refused wait. The sibling case 'an open ask card of this stop hides the session's wait in its news' keeps L4-creds-3's behaviour: it passes before and after.
fixed.check_in_the_app: No ordinary walk reaches this, because settleAsks closes an ask card whose stop has ended at the next wake. It is covered by the composed test. Live check: none needed.

new_problems: Sibling not changed (l4-cred-screens' region by shared_files: POST /sessions' validation status). POST /sessions still checks continuations.waiting before startBlocked. So a start from the API, the phone or the session page's Continue, made while a refused credential's session is kept, is answered with 'Your session of 10:00 goes on by itself once its Claude credential is back.' (claim_conflict) instead of the dialog's 'Nothing can run until you save a new API key in Settings.'. The Start dialog's own Start is off in that state, so the dialog itself is not affected. Suggested fix for l4-cred-screens: answer a refused credential's wait first there too, as session.start now does.

continuations.waiting (compose.ts keptWait) says 'once its Claude credential is back' for a refused credential. That sentence names no step (design section 5 rule 8). Chat no longer says it, but the session page's ended-to-wait block and the running bar's goes-on line may still read from it (l4-cred-screens / l4-starts-sessions).

The recorder writes the bench daemon's token in the URL of 'requestfailed' lines in steps/problems.jsonl when a daemon restarts (scripts/bench/recorder.cjs). It is a short-lived bench token, which I redacted in my evidence copy, but the recorder could redact it itself.
notes_for_other_areas: session.start (packages/commands/src/commands/session.ts) now checks refuseBlockedStart (the startBlocked port, the Start dialog's refusal) before refuseWhileWaiting (the startWaits port, the S-10 one-wait rule), in both plan() and run(). An area that adds a blocker to startBlocked gets it said before the kept-session sentence.
Chat's startBlocked port in compose.ts passes a credential wait whenever it carries a save link (a refusal) and is not startable, kept or not. A resting credential's wait is never passed there.

askFormAfterAnswer (run-indicator.ts) finds ask cards with list({ kind: 'approval', project_id: null, task_id: null }, newest first). If ensureAskCard ever files a card with another kind or a project, update this reader.
ToldByCards.credential (runner.ts) now needs the ask card's stop_key to equal the wait's stopKey, and counts a refused card only for a refused wait.
